notes.title: Version V2 B Plus Patch Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This is to let everyone know that a patch is coming out soon for an additional user interface settings, typos and rewrite fixes were done. 

Some key plot hints in the first rewrite patch was lost. Those are being added back in. 

Also one of the game's "illusions" was a little too difficult to figure out without using meta-reasoning. More hints to the true nature of the illusion are going to be added.

Just keep in mind that the storyline can move on with or without the player and that nearly every NPC lies to you at some point.

tags.bug: typos and rewrite fixes were done.

tags.feature: Those are being added back in.
More hints to the true nature of the illusion are going to be added.
